urls.title: YouTube URLs or video IDs
urls.description: Video URLs (watch, youtu.be, Shorts, live, embed) or 11-character video IDs. Channel URLs (@handle, /channel/UC…, add /videos, /shorts or /streams to pick a tab) and playlist URLs are expanded into their videos.

maxVideosPerSource.title: Max videos per channel or playlist
maxVideosPerSource.description: How many of the newest videos to take from each channel or playlist URL. Individual video URLs are always included.

languages.title: Preferred languages
languages.description: Caption languages in order of preference, as ISO codes (en, es, pt-BR, …). For each language, human-made captions are preferred over auto-generated ones.

allowAutoGenerated.title: Allow auto-generated captions
allowAutoGenerated.description: Use YouTube's automatic (speech recognition) captions when no human-made captions exist in a preferred language.

fallbackToAnyLanguage.title: Fall back to any available language
fallbackToAnyLanguage.description: If no preferred language exists, return the video's default caption track instead of an error.

translateTo.title: Translate to
translateTo.description: Optional language code (e.g. en, es, de). If the video has no captions in this language, YouTube's machine translation of the best track is returned.

formats.title: Output formats
formats.description: What to include for each video: plain text (`transcript`), timestamped `segments`, and/or ready-to-use `srt` / `vtt` subtitle files.

includeMetadata.title: Include video metadata
includeMetadata.description: Add channel, publish date, duration, views, likes, category, keywords, description and thumbnail to each item.

onlyNew.title: Only new videos (monitoring)
onlyNew.description: Return only videos whose transcript was not returned by an earlier run with the same URLs and languages. Add channel or playlist URLs and schedule the actor (e.g. daily) to get transcripts of new uploads: the first run is a baseline, later runs output (and bill) only new videos. Failed videos are retried next run. State is kept in the key-value store "youtube-transcripts-state" in your account.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: YouTube blocks many datacenter IPs, so residential proxies are the default and recommended. Proxy costs are included in the price.
